race.title: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: DEARKEITHANDKATY resumed progress sent chasing after 5 months off when successful at Carlisle (2½m) 5 weeks ago and with the return to further firmly in his favour, he looks to have plenty going for him on the back of a 5 lb rise. This is competitive, though, with Worcester eyecatcher In The Age worthy of note for the Skeltons. Slaney Opera and Jeteye are a pair arriving in red-hot form and also command plenty of respect. DEARKEITHANDKATY (FR) IN THE AGE (FR) SLANEY OPERA (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Dearkeithandkaty (5/2), Jeteye (3/1), Slaney Opera (4/1), Rockinastorm (9/2), Ski Lodge (10/1), Trac (10/1), The Big Breac (16/1), Redeeming Love (25/1), One More Stroke (25/1), In The Age (50/1), Daly Boy (66/1), Dunworley (100/1)
